title: Happy pig
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='24' fill='#ff9ec7'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='78' width='10' height='14' rx='5' fill='#f2739f'/>
  <rect x='60' y='78' width='10' height='14' rx='5' fill='#f2739f'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M28 40 L24 22 L40 34 Z' fill='#f2739f'/>
  <path d='M72 40 L76 22 L60 34 Z' fill='#f2739f'/>
  <path d='M31 38 L28 27 L38 35 Z' fill='#ffc2dd'/>
  <path d='M69 38 L72 27 L62 35 Z' fill='#ffc2dd'/>
  <!-- head base circle for cheeks -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='26' fill='#ffb3d4'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='41' r='4' fill='#5b2b45'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='41' r='4' fill='#5b2b45'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='39.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='39.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='5' fill='#ff7fae'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='52' r='5' fill='#ff7fae'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#f2739f'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='55' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#8a2f52'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='55' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#8a2f52'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 65 Q50 71 58 65' stroke='#8a2f52' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- curly tail -->
  <path d='M79 58 q8 -4 6 -10 q-2 -5 -7 -3 q-4 2 -2 6' stroke='#f2739f' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
